title: Canonical module tensor pullback square on stalks
statement: Let f:X→Y be a morphism of schemes, x∈X, and M,N arbitrary sheaves of modules on Y. Set SX=moduleStalkFunctor(X,x), SY=moduleStalkFunctor(Y,f(x)), E=extendScalars(f.stalkMap(x)), and H=tensorPullback(f). Let p:H;SX≅SY;E be the specific natural isomorphism chosen from exists_tensorPullback_stalk_iso [lem-weil-pbc-module-stalk-pullback]. Let tx and ty be the canonical tensor stalk comparisons chosen from stalkTensorIso on (X,x) and (Y,f(x)) [lem-pc-ringed-space-module-stalk-tensor], and c the canonical module pullback tensor comparison chosen from module_pullback_tensor(f) [lem-weil-pbc-module-pullback-tensor]. Then μ_E(SY M,SY N).hom;E(ty(M,N).inv);p.inv_(M tensor N);SX(c(M,N).hom);tx(HM,HN).hom = p.inv_M tensor p.inv_N. This is a statement about modules, with no cochain complexes, totalizations, cartesian square, derived categories, or auxiliary chain map. Zero stalk rings and zero modules are allowed.

source.place: Tags 01CD and 01CB; Tag 0098; generator calculation omitted in 01CD

proof.text: Set l=p_(M tensor N);E(ty(M,N)) and r=tx(HM,HN);(p_M tensor p_N). To show l.inv;SX(c);r.hom=μ_E.inv, use ModuleCat.ExtendScalars.hom_ext, then TensorProduct.induction_on. Additivity settles zero and sums. For a pure tensor of two stalk vectors, represent both by sections on a common neighborhood, obtained by intersection. The source tensor stalk germ formula and pullback stalk germ formula compute l.hom on the pulled-back tensor germ as one tensor the tensor of the original germs. Apply l.inv to this equality. The module pullback tensor germ formula sends that pulled-back tensor section to the tensor of the two pulled-back sections. The target tensor stalk formula and the two pullback stalk formulas then compute r.hom as the tensor of one tensor each original germ, exactly μ_E.inv on the generator. Thus the maps agree on all generators. Precompose by μ_E.hom and cancel p_M tensor p_N to obtain the displayed equation.
